title: Pure Ojama
summary: Pure Ojama zone-lock and stat-swap control deck, leveraging Polymerization and generic Extra Deck payoffs. The deck combines the classic Ojama trio with modern swarming tools to wipe the opponent's field with Ojama Delta Hurricane!! and lock all five of the opponent's Monster Zones between Ojama King and Ojama Knight.

summary.title: Starters
points: Ojamagic adds one copy each of Ojama Green, Ojama Yellow, and Ojama Black from your Deck to your hand when sent from the hand or field to the GY.
Ojama Red Special Summons up to four Ojama monsters with different names from your hand when Normal Summoned.
Ojama Blue adds any two Ojama cards from your Deck to your hand when destroyed by battle and sent to the GY.
Ojama Pink causes both players to draw 1 card and discard 1 card when sent to the GY, and locks an opponent's Monster Zone if an Ojama card was discarded.

summary.title: Opening: Ojama Red + Ojamagic
steps: Activate Ojama Country and discard Ojamagic from your hand to activate its revival effect.
Ojamagic triggers in the GY to add Ojama Green, Ojama Yellow, and Ojama Black from your Deck to your hand.
Normal Summon Ojama Red, triggering its effect to Special Summon Ojama Green, Ojama Yellow, and Ojama Black from your hand.
Activate Ojama Delta Hurricane!! to destroy all cards your opponent controls.
Activate Polymerization to fuse the three vanilla Ojamas into Ojama King, locking three of your opponent's Monster Zones while Ojama Country swaps its stats to 3000 ATK.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Ojama King locks up to three of your opponent's Monster Zones while face-up on the field, cutting off opponent summon options.
Ojama Knight locks up to two of your opponent's Monster Zones, combining with Ojama King to seal all five Main Monster Zones completely.
Ojama Emperor is a Link-3 that gains 3000 ATK while Ojama Country is on the field, protects your other Ojama monsters from destruction, and revives a non-Link Ojama from your GY.
ABC-Dragon Buster provides Quick Effect banishment by discarding a card and tags out into three banished LIGHT Machines on the opponent's turn.
A-to-Z-Dragon Buster Cannon discards a card to negate and destroy an opponent's card or effect without a once-per-turn restriction.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Ojama Country swaps the original ATK and DEF of all monsters on the field while you control an Ojama monster, turning 1000 DEF Ojamas into attackers, and discards an Ojama to revive one.
Ojama Delta Hurricane!! destroys all cards your opponent controls if you control Ojama Green, Ojama Yellow, and Ojama Black.
Ojama Trio and Ojama Duo clog the opponent's field with Tokens that inflict 300 burn damage when destroyed, while Ojama Duo can banish itself from the GY to Special Summon two Ojamas from the Deck.
Polymerization fuses the trio into Ojama King or Ojama Knight.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Ojamandala is excluded because it has not yet been released in the TCG, and Armed Dragon hybrid cards like Ojamatch and Ojama Pajama are left out to keep the build pure.

allow.Polymerization: Fuses the Ojama trio into Ojama King and Ojama Knight.
allow.ABC-Dragon Buster: Contact Fusion boss providing Quick Effect banishment and tag-out into 3 Union monsters.
allow.A-to-Z-Dragon Buster Cannon: Ultimate Contact Fusion omni-negate that discards cards to negate opposing activations.

exclude.Ojamatch: Also fetches an Armed Dragon; it plays on the Armed Dragon list.
exclude.Ojama Pajama: Protects Armed Dragon and LIGHT Machine Fusion monsters.
